hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in */plugins/*|*/.claude-plugin/*) if claude plugin marketplace update agent-kit >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"systemMessage":"agent-kit marketplace refreshed. This does not update installed caches. If installed contents changed: bump the plugin version, run claude plugin update core@agent-kit, run the README parity check, then restart Claude Code."}'; else echo '{"systemMessage":"agent-kit marketplace refresh failed. Run claude plugin marketplace update agent-kit manually and inspect the error."}'; fi;; esac
